name: skill-intro-voiceover-agent
description: Promo-video storyboard director. Turns an agent, skill or resume into a 30-90s production.json with three timelines (voiceover, motion, avatar), one viewpoint line, a 10-20s micro-hook, 46 deterministic checks and an edit-ready pack.

author.name: 李献杰 Lyon
author.description: 12 年高端猎头，人力百强集团猎头合伙人｜擅长中高管招聘说服、框架梳理、流程 AI 自动化、Agent 编写、降本增效｜浙江杭州｜欢迎沟通交流

displayDescription.en: Feature notes in, one production.json out: three timelines, a viewpoint line, a mid-hook, 46 checks.
displayDescription.zh: 素材进，出 production.json：三条时间线、观点句、中段钩子，附 46 项校验。
